Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill a few weeks ago and can truly say this is the best cooking grill that I have owned. I have cooked chicken , steak , hamburgers, sausages , salmon and vegetables with no issues. I can finally cook without huge fires on a gas grill. This grill gets hotter so its easier to cook indirectly. If it lasts like it cooks then it absolutely the best grill out there for 500 dollars.

Results.ReviewText: Just love our new grill....fires-up fast, heats evenly, and my husband  volunteers to make dinner almost every night (as long as it is bar-be-que!)

Results.ReviewText: Well put together, easy to clean, gas gauge,  and most important 4 wheels for easy maneuvering.

So far has performed wonderfully. Only negative: purchased cover does not completely cover bottom of grill. Would recommend.

Results.ReviewText:
Absolutely love my new Weber grill!!

Enjoy it so much I want to grill out every day!!

Results.ReviewText: My last Weber lasted 25 years. Replaced quite a few parts but it was the only grill that I could really cook on. It’s a no brainer that my new grill would be a Weber and I am not disappointed! The evenness of the sear and heat is unmatched if any other grill that I’ve used.

Results.ReviewText: I'm 60 years old and finally understand that you get what you pay for! I have used the cheap disposable grills for years that usually last a season or two, then place them at the curb. Finally I spent a little more and boy does it make a difference. My grill heats up fast and cooks a steak to perfection, with no flare ups. I am now defiantly a Weber grill customer forever! Thanks Weber!

Results.ReviewText: I was given this grill for an Xmas present in 2017.  Unfortunately, due to illness, I was not able to set it up till now. I gave my Genesis away to a neighbor and he is using it and loves it.  The few chances I have had to use the new grill have been excellent.  I tell everyone that asks me what grill to buy, they should get a Weber.

I now have to at times pus in and out the first button to light as for some reason gas wont start to come out if I don't. Other then that like I said I got 3 good years .

Results.ReviewText: I have owned my Weber grill for about a month now, and I am beyond pleased. I have been purchasing gas grill for over thirty years, none of which lasted more then 3 years, and were thinly stamped metal construction. The build quality of this grill is noticeable, but the real reward is the even cooking temperature in the grill, The added bonus of the fuel gauge built into the tank holder is pretty innovative also. Locking casters on the base that actually work the way they should are a simple pleasure when it comes to cleaning up the patio and moving the grill. Keep up the great work Weber!
Results.Title: Did I Mention Quality?

My only complaint is that it takes a lot of effort to keep it looking sparkling clean with all the stainless steel. I use a stainless cleaner for the dial panel and shelves after I use Weber grill cleaner using a Webber brush. Maybe I’m just neurotic sine I want to keep it looking new!

Results.ReviewText: This is a cooking experience not to missed.  The materiel are top quality, easy to clean, fast to get to temperature and reliable temperature.  It has taken a few bbqs to get used to this quality and I am still learning.  Only downside are the so called utensil hooks, they are small and plastic, none of my equipment would fit so we had to manufacture some wire extensions to make them work.  Our previous BBQ had excellent metal hooks free hanging on a metal bar.  With this caliber of BBQ that is a really bad design which is why I gave it only 4 stars
Results.Title: Way beyond any previous bbqs I have owned

Results.ReviewText:
My father always had Webers and so my first Grill I bought was a spirit Grill I bought in 1996. It replaced a few items over the years and technically it still was working when I bought my second Weber.  I have to say I'm very pleased with my purchase of the Spirit E310. It cooks even and perfect. It took only one or two times to get used to the burners going the opposite direction for my old Weber. The E310 has three burners, left middle and right. I like this arrangement better. So far I've cooked chicken, salmon, shrimps and all sorts of vegetables. 
I also like the easy touch electric ignition system as compared to the red button hammer 
igniter.  The construction looks solid and the caster wheels are more sturdy than my previous version.
Results.Title: My replacement for my 20year old Spirit Grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill is worth every penny! Wasted money on other grills for years.
Results.Title: Best grill I ever owned!!

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill a couple of months ago and it was easy to assemble and works really well.  The controls are simple and everything works exactly as it should.
Results.Title: Nice grill

Results.ReviewText:
I purchased Spirit E-310 about 3 months ago.  It is the best grill I have ever owned. It was well worth the price compared to my past experience with less expensive grills. This grill is perfect for a small family, in our case it’s just my wife and I.   You can still serve quite a few people from this size grill. 

 I am no expert barbecue guy by a long shot. That said, I will say that the Weber Grill has made me a much better barbecue guy. Primarily the reason is the guide  that they provided. I would never have dreamed of grilling baby back ribs but I did it just last weekend. I’ve cooked steaks all types and thickness, pork chops, burgers, brats, kielbasa, and ribs. All have turned out great thank you Weber.

You can purchase a cheaper one that will get the job done but if you want one that will last.......get a Weber.  I rated assembly a 4 because the one I purchased came preassembled.

Results.ReviewText: After years of replacing rusted out burners or grates or drip trays or...whatever, every year on cheaper grills (if the parts were even available) I decided to try a higher level brand. I can tell you just from assembling the Weber E-310 grill, it is made of high quality parts and solid construction. I've only had it for about a month so I can't say how long it will last; but my expectations are high. Cooking is very good. It heats up quickly and grilling is easy with temps slightly lower in the front and slightly higher in the rear allows you to move food around as needed and the upper rack is great for those items you want to cook a little longer. One minor item that I am very happy with is the absence of a side burner...I never used them in the past but could never find a grill that didn't include one. It is nice to have two solid shelves instead.

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
